(bottom row) Suzie, Timmy, Billy, and Tilly]] '''Brock's siblings''' are the nine younger brothers and sisters of {{an|Brock}}, and recurring characters who appeared in {{aniseries|PTS}}. They are the children of {{ka|Flint}} and [[Lola]], and appear to all be relatively close in age. They all first appeared under Brock's care in the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP005|Showdown in Pewter City]]''. The most notable among them is the oldest son after Brock, '''[[Forrest]]''' (Japanese: '''ジロウ''' ''Jirō''), who was first referred to by name and became more defined than the rest of the children in ''[[HS01|A Family That Battles Together Stays Together!]]''. The remaining children's names were listed in ''[[AG177|Grating Spaces]]'': '''Salvadore''' (Japanese: '''サブロウ''' ''Saburō''), '''Yolanda''' ('''ヨモコ''' ''Yomoko''), '''Tommy''' ('''ゴロウ''' ''Gorō''), '''Cindy''' ('''ムツコ''' ''Mutsuko''), '''Suzie''' ('''ナナコ''' ''Nanako''), '''Timmy''' ('''ヤオキ''' ''Yaoki''), and the twins '''Billy''' ('''クロウ''' ''Kurō'') and '''Tilly''' ('''トオコ''' ''Tōko''). Like Brock and their father, they all have very narrow, squinty eyes and coarse textured hair. None of the children inherited Lola's eyes, though some seem to have skin and hair color closer in tone to their mother's. ==History== [[File:Brock siblings SM.png|250px|thumb|Brock's siblings in {{aniseries|SM}}]] ===Pre-series=== Prior to ''[[EP005|Showdown in Pewter City]]'', their parents {{ka|Flint}} and [[Lola]] left the family home to pursue their respective goals, leaving {{an|Brock}} in charge. The children would often watch Brock's {{pkmn|battle}}s against [[Gym]] challengers and cheer him on, as seen in the episode proper. ==={{aniseries|OS}}=== The siblings were first seen in ''[[EP005|Showdown in Pewter City]]'', as {{ka|Flint}} covertly showed {{Ash}} their family home as they were being cared for by {{an|Brock}}. Later in the episode, they cheered on Brock in his [[Gym]] challenge rematch against Ash, even going as far as trying to physically restrain Ash from defeating {{TP|Brock|Onix}} and winning the match. Towards the end of the episode, Brock decided to pursue his own {{pkmn|journey}} with Ash and {{an|Misty}} after Flint returned home, leaving Brock's siblings and the Gym in their father's care. ===[[Pokémon Chronicles]]=== By ''[[HS01|A Family That Battles Together Stays Together!]]'', Lola had also returned and went on to redecorate the Pewter Gym and declare it a {{type|Water}} facility, much to the children's dismay. Brock also returned briefly, before leaving for the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], but not before restoring the Gym to its heritage {{type|Rock}} theme after defeating Lola in battle. ==={{aniseries|RS}}=== In ''[[AG177|Grating Spaces]]'', Brock's siblings were once again left alone after Flint and Lola went on a plane trip organized by {{TRT}}, who were [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|posing as Gym stylists]], and redecorated the Pewter Gym in a bid to take over the facility. Brock visited home and was shocked to see his parents' absences and the Gym's latest renovation. When the pair returned from their trip, Brock scolded them for abandoning the children once again and informed them that they had fallen for one of Team Rocket's schemes. ==={{aniseries|DP}}=== In [[DPS02]], they cheered [[Forrest]] on as he battled a [[Nurse Joy]] from the [[Pokémon Inspection Agency]]. Despite Forrest's loss, Brock's siblings were relieved after Joy allowed the Pewter Gym to continue being an official Gym. ==={{aniseries|SM}}=== Most recently, Forrest and the rest of Brock's siblings reappeared in a fantasy during the [[Poké Problem]] segment of [[SM042]]. ==Character== Brock's siblings are generally happy in spite of their abandonment. They have a strong camaraderie among themselves and Brock's Pokémon, such as {{TP|Brock|Ludicolo}} and {{TP|Brock|Sudowoodo}}. They are deeply attached to the [[Pewter Gym]] and all of them prefer the {{t|Rock}} type. All of the children are extremely close to their older brother Brock, and they view him as more of a parental figure than their own parents due to their general absence in their lives. They all love and respect him; in their debut episode, when he was losing a {{pkmn|battle}}, they all grabbed onto {{Ash}} because they knew Brock didn't want to have his {{TP|Brock|Onix}} hurt. Whenever Brock battles at the Gym, his siblings watch on and always root for him. With the exception of [[Forrest]], they are too young to {{pkmn|training|train}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and have none of their own. Salvadore, as the third-eldest brother, acts as [[Battle judge|referee]] during Forrest's battles at the Gym, although if Brock is battling, Forrest himself takes over this responsibility. ==Pokémon== {{main|Forrest#Pokémon|Forrest → Pokémon}} ===Borrowed from Brock=== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Brock |pkmn=Ludicolo |type1=Water |type2=Grass |img=Brock siblings Ludicolo.png |epnum=AG012 |epname=The Lotad Lowdown |vajp=Fumihiko Tachiki |vaen=Eric Stuart |vaennote=[[AG105]]-[[AG124]] |vaen2=Bill Rogers |vaen2note=[[AG177]]-present |desc=When Brock visited the Pewter Gym after returning from [[Hoenn]], he found that his siblings loved having Ludicolo around, and therefore, when he left to rejoin {{Ash}}, he decided to leave Ludicolo with his siblings.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{rock color light}} |caption=[[Forrest#Voice actors|Forrest]]|extra-style=display: inline-table |ja=朴璐美 ''[[Romi Park]]'' |en=[[Andrew Rannells]] ([[HS01]])

佐々木日菜子 ''Hinako Sasaki'' ([[AG177]], [[DPS02]]) }} ==Trivia== [[File:Brock and siblings.png|thumb|250px|Brock is welcomed home by his siblings]] * The names Tommy, Cindy, Suzie, and Timmy were first used in the siblings' debut episode, ''[[EP005|Showdown in Pewter City]]'', in {{aniseries|OS}}, though it was unknown, at the time, to which siblings {{an|Brock}} was referring to. * The youngest of Brock's siblings, Tōko, was referred to by her Japanese name in the [[Pokémon Chronicles]] episode ''[[HS01|A Family That Battles Together Stays Together!]]''. However, when ''[[AG177|Grating Spaces]]'' aired later, in {{aniseries|RS}}, she was referred to as Tilly, so the former may have been a [[dub]]bing error. * All of Brock's younger siblings contain a numeric element in their name: ** Jirō: 二郎 ''Jirō'', second son ** Saburō: 三郎 ''Saburō'', third son ** Yomoko: 四 ''yo-'', four ** Gorō: 五郎 ''Gorō'', fifth son ** Mutsuko: 六つ ''mutsu-'', six ** Nanako: 七 ''nana-'', seven (girl) ** Yaoki: 八 ''ya-'', eight ** Kurō: 九郎 ''Kurō'', ninth son ** Tōko: 十 ''tō-'', ten *It is implied in ''[[Pocket Monsters: The Animation]]'' that Brock's siblings and possibly even Brock himself may be half-siblings, as it mentioned that Lola, prior to ultimately abandoning her family, had "married again and again and had dozens of kids" in a desperate attempt to keep [[Pewter Gym]] open. ==Names== {| style="float:left; background: #{{rock color light}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{rock color}}" |- style="text-align:center" !
